updates.body: Tired of staring at the same four walls? Break out. Still Got It Collective is serving up the antidote to your February funk: signature dance vibes, curated whiskey flights, and a packed room ready to move. Winter ends when you say it does.

updates.title: Choose Your Dancer!
updates.body: Need a break? We've got a little surprise at bored.stillgotitcollective.com — a throwback game that'll take you straight back to the arcade days. Jump, dodge, and chase that high score. No judgment if you find yourself playing "just one more round" instead of answering emails.
